description: Line-count FLOOR ledger for governance documents (SPCC §4.4 analogue, GRD-001 item 4). A governance doc may GROW freely (we add rows), but it must never drop BELOW its recorded floor: silent truncation is exactly the REL-003 incident class. Counts are `wc -l` (newline count) per E-101. Lowering a floor is an authorized truth-correction action — record the reason here; do not lower it to turn a guard green.
